inputs.diff_summary: Java emits path id ExplicitLeaf84613-to-Peer84617 while Rust emits Outer84611.ExplicitLeaf84613-to-Peer84617; path coordinates differ only at formatter/rounding scale.
Java accepts stereotype-before-color package syntax and renders Leaf84631 as an empty package entity; Rust misses the package declaration and later materializes Leaf84631 as a class from the link.

findings.summary: Nested explicit empty package links still use a fully qualified package name in Rust path ids.
findings.evidence: checker_intrinsic_lr_explicit_cloud_nested_linked.puml fails: Java path id is ExplicitLeaf84613-to-Peer84617; Rust path id is Outer84611.ExplicitLeaf84613-to-Peer84617. Rust relationship_endpoint_name only normalizes ClassEntity ids and returns package endpoint ids unchanged.
findings.scope: dependent identity/rendering gap on the nested linked topology axis; it does not directly falsify intrinsic image dimension ownership.

findings.summary: Rust package parsing rejects Java-valid stereotype-before-color package declarations.
findings.evidence: checker_intrinsic_lr_package_style_cloud_stereotype_color.puml is accepted by Java CommandPackage/CommandPackageWithUSymbol, where stereotype/tags/url appear before color, but Rust try_package requires optional #color before optional <<stereotype>>. Rust then treats Leaf84631 as a class created by the relationship.
findings.scope: valid PlantUML parser divergence on the packageStyle cloud plus linked-topology axis; not an intrinsic-dimension arithmetic falsification.

findings.summary: The core intrinsic-dimension ownership claim survived the clean controls.
findings.evidence: Top-level LR explicit cloud, TB explicit cloud, and TB packageStyle cloud empty leaves all matched Java byte-structurally through diff_one --no-oracle.
findings.scope: supports the account's separation of solved placement from intrinsic empty-image dimensions for the exercised clean cases.

verdict_reason: The intrinsic-dimension account was not directly disproven by the clean controls, but the requested held-out axes include nested/linked and packageStyle cloud cases. Two valid PlantUML perturbations on those axes fail, so this mechanism cannot be accepted under the T14 held-out adversarial gate.
